fields.label: Event Key
fields.description: Which business event uses this template (pre-filled - do not change). e.g. po_needs_approval

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Tick to activate this template once its Airtel Template Id is filled and Meta-approved. Off = skipped.

fields.label: Template Name / Id
fields.description: The approved template reference for your provider. WhatsHub360: the template NAME (e.g. order_update). Airtel IQ: the templateId (e.g. 01j6rmpxaypjmrv3pe5n4naqdp).

fields.label: Message Variables (recipe, in order)
fields.description: The values that fill your template's {{1}},{{2}},... IN ORDER, comma-separated. Add/remove tokens to match the template's variable count; change a token to change its content. Tokens: approver, doc_type, doc_no, status, raised_by, amount, cost_center, supplier, date, reason, company, field:<fieldname> (any document field), text:<fixed words>. Blank = default (approver, doc_type, doc_no, status, raised_by). Example: approver, doc_type, doc_no, status, raised_by

fields.label: Quick-Reply Button Payloads
fields.description: ONLY if this template has Quick Reply buttons. One callback payload per quick-reply button, in button order, comma or newline separated (e.g. OK  or  Yes,No). Static Call / URL buttons need NO entry. Leave blank for templates with no quick-reply buttons. (Airtel sends these as message.payload[].)
